project_name: ParaTech - Gestion Technique de Matériel Parachutiste

theme.background: White (#FFFFFF) and crisp subtle slate grey background tones (#F8FAFC, #F1F5F9)

typography.heading_font: Chivo, Outfit, or System Sans-Serif (Clean, technical, high-legibility)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace (for serial numbers, dates, jump counts)

ui_principles.buttons: Large, tactile, high-contrast action buttons (h-11 to h-12, px-6, text-base, rounded-lg) designed for quick desktop operation.
ui_principles.layout_mode: No generic stats/counter cards on home page hero. The home page directly presents the list of parachutes as prominent LONG HORIZONTAL RECTANGLES.
ui_principles.horizontal_rectangle_item: Each parachute row is a wide horizontal container (`p-5 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:border-blue-500 hover:shadow-md transition-all`). It contains a left header section (Rig Identifier/Serial + Type + Total Jumps) and 4 distinct, equally balanced horizontal columns/cards representing SAC, VOILE PRINCIPALE, VOILE DE SECOURS, APPAREIL DE SÉCURITÉ with their individual validity badges.
ui_principles.detail_view: Clicking a parachute opens a comprehensive detail view/modal featuring 4 interactive main sub-cards (SAC, VOILE PRINCIPALE, VOILE DE SECOURS, APPAREIL DE SÉCURITÉ), jump counters (total + jumps since last lines/cône change), cone change history timeline, reserve packing history with auto-calculated expiration dates (e.g. 6 months/180 days standard rule), maintenance & repair logs, and action bar (Edit, Archive, Print A4, Export JSON).
ui_principles.navigation: Header bar with app title 'ParaTech', search bar, filter triggers (Status, Rig Type, Archived), + NOUVEAU PARACHUTE primary CTA, Import/Export JSON backup tools, Print view trigger, Settings modal trigger.

key_features_to_implement: 1. Home Page Horizontal Rectangle List with instant search, multi-filter dropdown (Valide / Péremption proche / Périmé / Archivé) and sorting.

2. New/Edit Parachute Form Modal (fields for Rig ID/Identifier, Owner/Ref, Sac model/serial/DOM, Main Canopy model/serial/size/DOM/lines count, Reserve Canopy model/serial/DOM/last repack date/validity duration, AAD/Safety Device model/serial/DOM/next battery service date).
3. Interactive Detail View with 4 Sub-Cards (Sac, Voile Principale, Voile Secours, Appareil de Sécurité).
4. Jump Counter Manager (+1 Jump, +5 Jumps, custom add, + resetting/tracking jumps since last lines/cône replacement).
5. Lines/Cône Change History (Log date, technician, line set type, jump counter at change).
6. Reserve Repack History (Log date, rigger name, certificate #, automatically calculates 6-month validity deadline and status badge).
7. Maintenance & Repair Log (Date, description, type, cost/time, technician).
8. Automatic Validity Status Calculation (Vert = >30 days remaining, Orange = <=30 days remaining or 90% cone life, Rouge = expired date or max jumps exceeded).
9. Offline Storage Engine (IndexedDB + localStorage fallback with sample initial parachute data so app is immediately populated).
10. Backup & Restore (JSON Export of full database & JSON Import validation).
11. A4 Print Formatted View (@media print stylesheet for clean printable equipment cards and fleet lists).
12. Settings Modal (Configure validity period days, max jumps per lines set threshold, warning thresholds).
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust, clean desktop web application in React JS using Tailwind CSS and Lucide React icons.
Ensure all components use .js or .jsx file extensions.
Do NOT add generic analytics counters at the top of the home page. Jump straight into the list of parachutes rendered as long horizontal rectangles.

Store all data in IndexedDB/localStorage with pre-populated realistic parachute equipment items (e.g. Mirage G4, Vector 3, Javelin Odyssey, Icarus Safire 3, PD Reserve, Cypress 2, Vigil Cuattro) so it works 100% offline out-of-the-box.
Ensure every interactive element has a clear data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
Ensure buttons are large (h-11, px-5, text-base) and visually clean.
Implement A4 print styles using @media print so clicking Print generates a pristine printable technical sheet without navigation headers.
Toast notifications using Sonner for user actions (jump added, repack saved, JSON imported, backup exported).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate (e.g. sticky header, modal overlays).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Lucide React icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
